title: Enterprise Request Enrichment + TRL Scoring for Rapid Scoping
creator: Alex Morgan
description: Problem: Sales/CS submits many high-touch enterprise feature asks with inconsistent fields. Current first-pass scoping is manual and varies by rep, causing delays and lost prioritization signal. Goal: Ship a lightweight request enrichment layer that augments incoming enterprise asks with standardized metadata and a Technical Readiness Level (TRL) score to speed prioritization and routing to PM/Eng.
acceptance_criteria: Incoming enterprise requests are automatically enriched with at least 4 standardized metadata fields (use-case, expected TPS, regulatory constraint, data residency) for >= 90% of submissions
TRL score computed for each enriched request and recorded on the ticket with rationale for >= 85% of tickets
CS triage playbook updated with a 3-step checklist and a 2-minute per-request target for enrichment completion
Dashboard shows distribution of TRL buckets (1-5) and time-to-first-scope; target: median time-to-first-scope reduced by 40% in Cycle 45
notes: We intentionally keep TRL lightweight (5 buckets) and purpose-built for scoping speed not engineering rigor
Design will reuse existing intake form but add an ‘enrichment’ batch job and optional CS quick-edit flow
Plan to pilot with three high-touch accounts (Acct A / Acct B / Acct C) before wider roll-out
Enrichment should be auditable and editable by CS; source-of-truth remains the Linear ticket fields
comments: 2025-10-28 Alex Morgan: Initial write-up after discovery sessions with Sales and two Solutions Engineers. Common missing fields: expected throughput, data sensitivity, compliance constraints, and desired SLA.
